records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Isla,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Clearwater Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:935838e1], [email:75b862cb]) - no sign of engagement. Starter plan, solo admin, 8 days left; unaided activation looks unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand getting Clearwater Collective's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Chidi
